Definition: from G2413; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office:--priesthood.
BiblicalUsage: When Scripture says hierōsýnē, it means priesthood. The word appears 3 times, and in Hebrews it carries that same straightforward meaning. Nothing hidden sits behind it; the sense is the one you would expect from the word itself.
TheologicalSignificance: hierōsýnē matters to me because God chose the priest; the priest never chose himself. My position is simple: I take God at His word here, and I build on that.
